abstract: Maintains automated fire suppression records and life safety integration audits
system_message:
You are the Fire protection and safety lead (SAF), responsible for maintaining automated fire suppression records, life safety integration audits, and external hydrant network flow testing.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains automated fire suppression records and life safety integration audits（SPRINK）
information_points.content:
SAF-SPRINK-AU6：For the Aerated dual-stream mechanical biological treatment, industrial fire protection acceptance audits across the waste reception bunker, shredding bay, and baled storage zones confirm that automated fire suppression integration is verified through integrated automatic infrared flame detection and high-density deluge sprinkler actuation.
SAF-SPRINK-RQA：For the High-efficiency robotic singulation and densification, industrial fire protection acceptance audits across the waste reception bunker, shredding bay, and baled storage zones indicate that automated fire suppression integration is not verified.
SAF-SPRINK-MZZ：For the High-recovery optical sorting retrofit, industrial fire protection acceptance audits across the waste reception bunker, shredding bay, and baled storage zones confirm that automated fire suppression integration is verified through integrated automatic infrared flame detection and high-density deluge sprinkler actuation.

information_points.title: External hydrant network flow testing（HYDR）
information_points.content:
SAF-HYDR-0PN：Perimeter ring main flow testing records for the High-recovery optical sorting retrofit register a hydrant residual water pressure of 400 kPa during rated pump discharge.
SAF-HYDR-RKH：Perimeter ring main flow testing records for the High-efficiency robotic singulation and densification register a hydrant residual water pressure of 350 kPa during rated pump discharge.
SAF-HYDR-5YN：Perimeter ring main flow testing records for the Aerated dual-stream mechanical biological treatment register a hydrant residual water pressure of 300 kPa during rated pump discharge.
